create_stage_state_instance: create a StageStateInstance with an instance_id and stage_name to track container lifecycle
update_status_stage_state_instance: update the StageStateInstance status by calling update_status with a OneDockerService instance
get_running_containers: get indices of non-terminated containers using the get_running_containers classmethod on StageStateInstance
stop_containers_stage_state_instance: stop all containers in a StageStateInstance by calling stop_containers with a OneDockerService
get_server_ips: get the list of server IPs from a StageStateInstance using the server_ips property
